title: Velocity of a Rock After Deer Scatter
body: Three 70-kg deer are standing on a flat 200-kg rock that is on an ice-covered pond. A gunshot goes off and the deer scatter, with deer A running at $$(15\,\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}})\hat{i}+(5.0\,\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}})\hat{j}$$, $$deer$$ $$B$$ $$running$$ $$at$$ $$-(12\,\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}})\hat{i}+(8.0\,\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}})\hat{j}$$, $$and$$ $$deer$$ $$C$$ $$running$$ $$at$$ $$(1.2\, \tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}})\hat{i}-(18.0\, \tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}})\hat{j}$$.
